create_graph_with_nodes_and_arcs: create a gtn Graph with start and accept nodes connected by labeled arcs with optional weights
save_and_load_graph: save a gtn Graph to disk using savetxt or save and reload it with loadtxt or load
create_scalar_graph: create a scalar gtn Graph from a single weight value using gtn.scalar_graph for autograd operations
run_scalar_ops_with_backward: run scalar operations like negate add and subtract on gtn Graphs and compute gradients with backward
run_parallel_graph_operations: run parallel operations like concat remove and parallel_for on lists of gtn Graphs for batch processing
